TextUsedForAnnotation: Request Number - 817 | Request Title - Display shorter fingerprint, enable sharing of fingerprint | Request Description - To enable faster sharing of the fingerprint, let the user copy the fingerprint and send it over a secure channel (inform the user that the channel needs to be secure). Also, don't display the hex of the fingerprint but rather something the user can easily read out:  base58-encoding poetry-encoding
comment: The feature request describes a secure transmission mechanism, but it is unclear how that mechanism should be enacted, which may prevent enacting the request.
question: What mechanism should be used to ensure a channel is secure? Given that fingerprints are used to verify security, how should the exchange be performed in a secure manner prior to the receipt of a fingerprint that does not invalidate the purpose of the fingerprint?
interpretation: What mechanism should be used to ensure a channel is secure? Given that fingerprints are used to verify security, how should the exchange be performed in a secure manner prior to the receipt of a fingerprint that does not invalidate the purpose of the fingerprint?
missing_information: "specify which part of the system the fingerprint belongs to", "clarify the method of how the user will copy the fingerprint", "define what 'base58-encoding' and 'poetry-encoding' entail and how they are implemented", "confirm if any existing functionality needs modification or if new functionality is needed", "detail security requirements for the secure channel", "indicate any potential impacts on existing encryption or security features", "provide user interface guidelines for how the fingerprint should be displayed and copied", "clarify any error handling mechanisms if the fingerprint sharing fails", "list any dependencies or libraries necessary for encoding the fingerprint in the specified formats".
